settings.deepdive_a_headline: Wakes you at the perfect moment.
settings.deepdive_a_body: MOOV analyses your movement through the night and identifies the lightest phase of your sleep cycle — so your alarm never pulls you from deep sleep again.
settings.deepdive_b_body: A single quiet tone. No jarring beeps. MOOV eases you into the morning with a gentle light sequence and soft chime that rises over 90 seconds.
settings.deepdive_c_body: Connect to WiFi and bring MOOV into your Sonos ecosystem, or switch to Bluetooth for standalone use anywhere.
